parts.text: Find the least value of $k$ for which $E(x)\ge0$ for every real $x$, proving that your value works.
parts.answer: 取 $x=3$ 得必要条件 $k\ge9$；当 $k=9$，$E=(x-3)^2\ge0$，故最小为9。
